final: WITH country_tallies AS (SELECT p.birth_country, COUNT(*) AS tally FROM player_college AS pc JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = pc.player_id GROUP BY p.birth_country), country_shares AS (SELECT birth_country, tally, tally * 1.0 / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share FROM country_tallies), above_average AS (SELECT tally, share, tally - (SELECT AVG(tally) FROM country_tallies) AS excess FROM country_shares WHERE tally > (SELECT AVG(tally) FROM country_tallies)) SELECT SUM(tally) AS combined_tally, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(excess) AS average_excess FROM above_average
